conversation_starters.title: Seven more beluga whales arrive at SeaWorld San Antonio from shuttered Canadian marine park
questions: Have you been to SeaWorld since the belugas arrived?
Is the whale relocation something people there are talking about?
conversation_starters.description: SeaWorld San Antonio received seven more beluga whales in a mission to relocate whales from a closed Canadian marine park, aiming to ensure their care and wellbeing.

you_should_know.title: ‘Taxation through electricity prices’: Abbott takes aim at city-owned utilities like CPS Energy
you_should_know.summary: A CPS worker finishes a job near Balcones Heights, a small city entirely surrounded by San Antonio, on Monday. The San Antonio-owned utility has kept rates low compared to other Texas metros, but Abbott doesn't like how its profits fuel the city budget.
